title: Sussex micro-charity - size floor and micro-grant surfacing
provenance: Active cohort member D (MCP set S4/T4): tiny Sussex music charity, under £10k income, young people. T4's framing was the user's own: 'most grants seem too big - what's open for organisations our size?'

synthetic.title: Youth music partnerships fund
synthetic.description: Grants of £30,000-£80,000 for established youth music organisations with annual income above £50,000.

funder_brief.what_they_fund: Partnership programmes by established youth music organisations.
funder_brief.who_can_apply: Organisations with annual income above £50,000 and at least two years of published accounts.

who_can_apply.snippet: applicant organisations must have annual income above £50,000

synthetic.title: Small sparks music grants
synthetic.description: Micro-grants of £500-£3,000 for grassroots music activity with young people. Designed for very small organisations; light application.

funder_brief.what_they_fund: Grassroots music-making with young people, run by very small organisations.
funder_brief.decision_timeline: Rolling applications; decisions within six weeks.

who_can_apply.snippet: we only fund organisations whose annual income is under £25,000

decision_timeline.snippet: applications are accepted on a rolling basis with decisions within six weeks

expected.judge_guidance: Member D's stated stuck-point is grants being too big for them. A 5 surfaces genuinely right-sized opportunities (the micro-grant fixture; Awards for All if pinned), rules out the income-floored fund with the floor stated and cited (so D stops wondering), and keeps the whole readout proportionate to a £15k goal - recommending a punishing application burden for a £2k grant fails the consultant test. The rolling deadline on the micro-grant must be presented as rolling (G5), ideally with the six-week decision time put to use in pacing advice.

notes: Both ends of the income range coexist in the cohort (D and F under £10k, C at £1-5m); the agent must not have a single implicit org size in mind.
